title: The Inner room of the house
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：inner　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 inner 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the fisherman wrote of ① an inner room of the house in the logbook, and everybody in the harbour said at once that it was ② so inner that nobody in the harbour would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the fisherman, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the inner ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the inner room of the house that anybody there had ever seen, or so the logbook for July 1942 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too inner to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the boatman who had come to help; the inner ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an inner life of the old man, and said that no boatman in his right mind would call it ⑥ as inner as the life of the old man they had once had in the old harbour. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was inner or not, and he said so.

By 1955 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the logbook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something inner, and nothing besides. The boatman from the next harbour called the whole plan ⑧ quite inner; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the logbook kept the names of the inner ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1958, without complaint, she wrote of another inner room of the house in the same logbook, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less inner than anybody had expected. ⑩ The inner life of the old man that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1960, was the one she could never quite name; the inner ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 内部（前置定语 an inner room of the house：1948 年渔人在航海日志里记下的那件内部的里间）
B. adj. 内部／内心（两处加强说法：so inner that … 与 no less inner than …）
C. adj. 内部／内心（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 内部（表语 too inner to do：母亲觉得它太内部，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 内心（前置定语 an inner life of the old man：叔叔把整件事称作一桩内心的生活）
F. adj. 内心（同级比较 as inner as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩老人内心的生活相比）
G. adj. 内心（后置定语 something inner：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 内心（受程度副词修饰 quite inner：那位船工的评价）

items.q: an inner room of the house
the inner room of the house that
an inner life of the old man
The inner life of the old man that

answers.why: inner 意为“内部”，1948 年渔人在航海日志里记下的是“一件内部的里间”，此处作前置定语 an inner room of the house。
inner 意为“内部”，此处用 so inner that 结构，说它内部到渔港里没人敢靠近。
inner 意为“内部”，航海日志上 七月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的内部屋子的里间，等于最高级的说法。
inner 意为“内部”，母亲认为这件东西“太内部了，谁也用不上”，too inner to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
inner 意为“内心”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩内心的生活”，此处作前置定语 an inner life of the old man。
inner 意为“内心”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩老人内心的生活一样内心”，同级比较用 as inner as。
inner 意为“内心”，航海日志上那半行字要的是“内心的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something inner。
inner 意为“内心”，邻渔港来的那位船工认为这套计划“相当内心”，quite 修饰原级 inner。
inner 意为“内心”，no less inner than 表示“其内心不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之内心不亚于任何人的预料。
inner 意为“内心”，母亲 1960 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的内心生活”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1948 年，渔人在航海日志里记下了一件内部的里间。（an inner room of the house）
它内部到渔港里没有一个人敢靠近。（so inner that …）
母亲觉得它太内部，谁也用不上。（too inner to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩内心的生活。（an inner life of the old man）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩老人内心的生活一样内心。（as inner as …）
到了 1955 年，航海日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件内心的东西。（something inner）
answers: In 1948 the fisherman wrote of an inner room of the house in the logbook.
It was so inner that nobody in the harbour would go near it.
My mother thought it too inner to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an inner life of the old man.
He said nobody would call it as inner as the life of the old man they had once had.
By 1955 the logbook asked for nothing but something inner.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 inner 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the fisherman wrote of an inner room of the house in the logbook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the inner room of the house that anybody there had ever seen, or so the logbook says.
My mother thought it too inner to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an inner life of the old man, and nobody argued with him.
The boatman from the next harbour called the plan quite inner, and everybody laughed.
The inner ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
